headline: Conservation Commission to review tree removal requests, wetlands filings, and enforcement orders for several properties.
summary: The meeting covers tree removal requests, notices of intent for dune fencing and an accessory dwelling unit, a sewer and electric line project, and enforcement matters for several properties. The commission will also review expenditure approvals and any pending orders of conditions.
